nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space. A curve $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to X$ is a closed geodesic if it is a geodesic defined on all of $\mathbb{R}$, it is periodic with some period $T > 0$ (that is, $\gamma(t + T) = \gamma(t)$ for all $t \in \mathbb{R}$), and it is not constant: $\gamma(t_1) \ne \gamma(t_2)$ for some $t_1, t_2 \in \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Closed geodesic

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space. For every point $p \in X$, the constant curve $\mathbb{R} \to X$, $t \mapsto p$, is a geodesic.
nodes.title: Constant curves are geodesics

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a real normed space. For all $p, v \in F$, the straight line $\mathbb{R} \to F$, $t \mapsto p + t v$, is a geodesic.
nodes.title: Straight lines are geodesics

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a real normed space and $p, v \in F$. For every set of times $s \subseteq \mathbb{R}$, the straight line $t \mapsto p + t v$ is a geodesic of speed $\|v\|$ on $s$.
nodes.title: Straight lines are geodesics of constant speed

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space with extended distance $d$, let $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to X$ be a curve, $s \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ a set of times and $c \ge 0$ a real number. The curve $\gamma$ is a geodesic of speed $c$ on $s$ if every $t \in s$ has some $\varepsilon > 0$ such that $d(\gamma(t_1), \gamma(t_2)) = c\,|t_1 - t_2|$ for all $t_1, t_2 \in s$ with $|t_1 - t| < \varepsilon$ and…
nodes.title: Geodesics of a given speed on a set of times

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space. A curve $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to X$ is a geodesic on a set of times $s \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ if, for some real number $c \ge 0$, it is a geodesic of speed $c$ on $s$.
nodes.title: Geodesic on a set of times

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space. A curve $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to X$ is a geodesic if it is a geodesic on the set of all times $\mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Geodesics defined for all times

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space. If $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to X$ is a closed geodesic, then for every $p \in X$, $\gamma$ is not the constant curve $t \mapsto p$.
nodes.title: Closed geodesics are not constant

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a pseudo-extended metric space. For every point $p \in X$, the constant curve $\mathbb{R} \to X$, $t \mapsto p$, is not a closed geodesic.
nodes.title: Constant curves are not closed geodesics

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
